description: Source code for managing custom profile attributes in Mattermost, including CRUD operations for CPA fields and values, with WebSocket notifications.

methods.name: CpaGroupID
methods.description: Retrieves the group ID for custom profile attributes from the property access service.

methods.name: GetCPAField
methods.description: Fetches a specific CPA field by ID, converting from property field.

methods.name: ListCPAFields
methods.description: Lists all CPA fields within the group, sorted by sort order.

methods.name: CreateCPAField
methods.description: Creates a new CPA field after validation and limit checks, then publishes a WebSocket event.

methods.name: PatchCPAField
methods.description: Updates an existing CPA field, optionally deleting associated property values if type changes, then publishes an update event.

methods.name: DeleteCPAField
methods.description: Deletes a CPA field and publishes a deletion event.

methods.name: ListCPAValues
methods.description: Lists property values for a specific user.

methods.name: GetCPAValue
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value by ID.

methods.name: PatchCPAValue
methods.description: Updates a single property value for a user.

methods.name: PatchCPAValues
methods.description: Batch updates multiple property values for a user, with validation and WebSocket notification.

methods.name: DeleteCPAValues
methods.description: Deletes all property values for a user and publishes an update event.
